title: Irrationality exponents of logarithms of positive rational numbers
summary: We study rational approximation to logarithms of positive rational numbers and give a separated-weight determinant argument for $μ(\log r)=2$ whenever $r\in\mathbb Q_{>0}\setminus\{1\}$. The geometric input is an interpolation theorem for logarithmic jets at points with distinct multiplicative coordinates. Its successive weight thresholds are independent of the interpolation centres; the eventual degree threshold may depend on them.
